items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yes I once listened to a supposedly erudite debate as to whether Poe would have written as well if he had not starved the way that he did.

ctx.x: He would say well that man wouldn't have done that well if he hadn't starved in the garret.
Yes I once listened to a supposedly erudite debate as to whether Poe would have written as well if he had not starved the way that he did. So that accounts for that. Well I

wanted to just deal with one or two more quotations of yours here. As you say, I've always been in the rhythm of whatever the contemporary rhythm is. And I just have a feeling that that doesn't do you quite justice because the way it comes out it makes you sound as if you are a follower and I think you are more of a leader.
